{"full_source_conversation":"supporter: Hi Anna, how have things been going for you lately?
seeker: Hey, it's been a bit tough to be honest.
supporter: I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like to talk about what's been happening?
seeker: Yeah, I had a fight with my boyfriend recently, and it's been weighing on me a lot.
supporter: That sounds really challenging. What was the fight about, if you don't mind sharing?
seeker: It was about our priorities and goals for the future. We seem to be on different pages, and I'm not sure how to handle it.
supporter: That can definitely be a hard topic to navigate. How are you feeling about the differences in your priorities?
seeker: I feel torn because I really care about him, but our visions for the future just aren't aligning right now.
supporter: It sounds like you're in a tough spot, wanting to find a balance between your feelings for him and your own future plans.
seeker: Exactly. I just don't want to lose him over this, but I also don't want to compromise too much on what I want for my future.
supporter: It's important to stay true to yourself while also considering the relationship. Have you talked to him about how you're feeling?
seeker: We did talk, but it didn't go well. We both ended up just getting more upset.
supporter: I'm sorry to hear that it escalated. Sometimes it can be helpful to take a break and approach the conversation with a fresh perspective.
seeker: Yeah, we haven't spoken much since the fight. I'm hoping we can find a way to discuss things more calmly.
supporter: That's a good goal. It might also help to think about what aspects of your goals are most important to you, and where you might have some flexibility.
seeker: That's true. I know I'll probably have to make some compromises, I just need to figure out which ones I'm okay with.
supporter: It sounds like you're being very thoughtful about the situation. It's okay to take your time to figure these things out.
seeker: Thanks. I just want to find a way to make things work between us without giving up too much of myself.
supporter: Having that intention is important. You deserve to have a relationship where you feel respected and supported in pursuing your own dreams too.
seeker: I hope so. It's just hard when someone you care about seems to be on a different path.
supporter: It's completely understandable. Relationships often require understanding and patience from both sides.
seeker: I'll try to keep that in mind. Thanks for listening, it helps a lot to talk things through.

{"full_source_conversation":"seeker: I feel heavy pressures from my parents, they also want me to be the top of the class but I find it tough because they are other top students
seeker: Please what do I do?
supporter: Hi! how are you doing today?
seeker: Not so good, I'm feeling down
supporter: It sounds like you have low energy. What makes you feel down?
seeker: My parents keep putting pressures on me to be the best in the class and with my learning difficulties I am finding it had to cope 
supporter: I can understand parental pressure. They want to see you to be a successful person. Sometime it is overwhelming. you should talk to them that you are doing your best.
seeker: I have tried, I am even doing extra classes but they still keep on putting pressure on me. On top of that all my friends have distant from me for no reason and they ganged up on me to bully me 
supporter: It must be tough time for you. show your work report to your parents and try to tell them all the people are born with different potential.
seeker: Hmm...That doesn't seem like a bad idea. I am just worry that my parents will not be very understanding. My parents are too strict and they don't like to hear any complaints or excuses.
supporter: Most of the parents behave like this when it is regarding their kids future. When I was in school same thing happened with mw. They know us very well I realized now.  Try to talk to them everyday for a while. It might work.
seeker: Maybe you're right! Although, my parents have a very busy schedule but fingers crossed when I do find time to talk to them they will understand me. 
seeker: I sometimes feel like someone older needs to talk to them, maybe then my parents may take it more seriously
seeker: Well! Thanks I give what you said a go
supporter: Hope you are feeling bit relaxed now. 
seeker: Yes! I feel a lot better now that I know someone understands how I feel 
supporter: I am glad that I am able to make you happy. 
seeker: One more thing
seeker: How should I respond to the friends that are ganging up on me?
supporter: sure! You don't have to worry about that. that should be their problem. just ignore them or don't give attention. They will stop doing it for sure.
seeker: Hmm..interesting because now that I think about it, I believe this could have contributed to the stress and anxieties that I have been experiencing. When I don't get support from anyone I feel so alone, timid and down 
supporter: Try to take small break while studying and try to relax 
seeker: Yes, I find that has helped me a bit also because I have quite a short attention span . Also, I am currently on the path of trying to find more unique techniques to help revision more fun and exciting for me 
supporter: That's great! you will do awesome.
seeker: Thank you very much! I feel much better now and I've taken on board what you said, hopefully there will be a positive change in my parents character. :)
supporter: You are welcome!
seeker: Alright! Well I'll talk to you some other time to give an update 
supporter: Sure! take care
seeker: Thanks you too! :)","kind":"MS","reported_at":"2024-07-10","schema":"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2","speaker_scope":"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography."}

supporter: Hello
seeker: How are you doing today?
supporter: I am doing well and how are you feeling today?
seeker: I'm feeling okay today, a bit anxious for my finals this week
supporter: Thank you for sharing, feeling anxious days before an exam is a normal. 
supporter: I am also anxious about my upcoming exam this week. 
seeker: What is the exam for?
supporter: I am preparing to sit to become a clinical counselor. I can relate to feeling anxious. You are not alone. 
supporter: What do you think is triggering your anxiety?
seeker: I think it might be the fear of failure that triggered it 
supporter: Research has shown that fear of failure does stem from feelings of anxiety, but is it possible to look at fear of failure from a different perspective?
seeker: I think it might be possible to look at it from a different perspective
supporter: Do you think you can channel your fear of failure into positive energy?
seeker: I think I probably could
seeker: How do you think I could do that?
supporter: You can turn your anxiety into extra energy to plan and prepare.  
supporter: Having anxiety can give you a boost of energy, which gives you an advantage to achieve your goal.
seeker: I can probably do that, the anxiety can motivate me to create a studying plan
supporter: Yes, indeed. Having anxiety will keep you anchored to your study plan which would increase your ability to perform well for the exam.   
seeker: I can do that 
supporter: Awesome! In addition, as you follow your study plan, remember to pace yourself.  
seeker: I will do that, thank you for your help
supporter: You are welcome, I hope this session was helpful. 
seeker: It was, thank you","kind":"MS","reported_at":"2024-09-30","schema":"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2","speaker_scope":"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography."}

{"full_source_conversation":"supporter: hi! Hope you are doing well today
supporter: How may I assist  you ?
seeker: Hey! I’ve been better. Just so stressed out! I don’t handle pressure well.
supporter: Something is pressuring you and you are stressed due to that. Correct me if I am wrong
seeker: That’s right. I have three final exams next week and I’ve had the flu so I haven’t been able to study at all.
supporter: It must be hard for you to prepare for it. I can understand. But there must be a way
seeker: I’m sure I can figure something out. I’ll definitely have to study all weekend. I just really need to pass. Do you know any good tricks to help study?
supporter: I can easily see your seriousness and dedication for  your studies. That is awesome thing
seeker: Thanks! Education is very important in my family. My dad was a teacher so I’ve always had to live up to high expectations.
supporter: you should take a complete rest for 2-3 hours without worrying and then get up and eat something tasty and healthy. Afterwards sit for preparing for your exam. That's what I do and it helps me a lot.
seeker: I love that idea! I think I’ll feel much better if I take that time to just relax before I really start working.
supporter: There is a famous quote " Worry is a total waste of time. It doesn't change anything. All it does is steal your joy and keep you busy doing nothing."
seeker: Whoever said that sure knew what they were talking about. It’s so true!
seeker: Any snack recommendations? I’ve got some fruit on hand, but it’s a little boring by itself lol
supporter: I definitely recommend trail mix or chex mix and one of my favorites is banana chips!
seeker: I don’t think I’ve ever tried banana chips! I’ll have to see if my grocery store has got them. Maybe I can get some delivered by the time I’m ready to study
supporter: you can find it in any grocery store easily known as  Plantain chips
supporter: hope you are feeling much better now
seeker: Thanks so much! I’ve added them and some of my favorite trail mix to my cart. Should be delivered in 1 hour!
seeker: I am feeling better. Thanks so much for the advice :)
supporter: That's great to know and best wishes for your exams.
seeker: Thank you. Enjoy the rest of your day!
supporter: you too!","kind":"MS","reported_at":"2024-09-25","schema":"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2","speaker_scope":"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography."}

turns.content: Hey Anna, it's good to see you online. How are you doing today?
Hi... honestly, not so great. It's been a rough week.
I'm really sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about what's been going on?
Yeah, I had an argument with my parents about my future plans, and it got really intense.
That sounds tough. What was the argument about, if you're comfortable sharing?
They want me to focus on getting into a good university, but I'm not even sure what I want to study yet.
It can be really overwhelming when you're not sure about your path, and there's pressure from others. How did that make you feel?
I just felt trapped and like I was disappointing them. It reminded me of the fight I had with my boyfriend about future plans too.
It's natural to feel that way when expectations feel piled up. How's everything with your boyfriend now?
We haven't really resolved things. It's this limbo where everything feels uncertain, and now my parents add to that stress.
That sounds like so much to carry all at once, Anna. It’s understandable to feel overwhelmed. What do you feel you need right now?
I think I need to figure out what I actually want for my future without feeling like I'm letting everyone down.
That's a really important realization. It's your future, after all. Have you had any thoughts about what interests or excites you?
I love art and writing, but I'm not sure if that's practical. It feels risky compared to more traditional paths.
